# HUNDESALON NIKA

HUNDESALON NIKA is a professional pet grooming salon in Leipzig, Germany. The site serves clients in German, English, Russian, and Ukrainian. The canonical public domain is https://hundesalon-nika.com/.

## Primary URLs

- German: https://hundesalon-nika.com/de/
- English: https://hundesalon-nika.com/en/
- Russian: https://hundesalon-nika.com/ru/
- Ukrainian: https://hundesalon-nika.com/uk/
- Sitemap: https://hundesalon-nika.com/sitemap.xml
- Brand sitemap: https://hundesalon-nika.com/sitemap-brand.xml
- Robots: https://hundesalon-nika.com/robots.txt

## Core Topics

- Dog grooming in Leipzig
- Cat grooming in Leipzig
- Pet bathing, brushing, hygiene care, fur care, creative cuts
- Online booking and salon contact
- Grooming prices and service information

## Language Routing

The root URL redirects visitors to a language version using Accept-Language first and Cloudflare country data as a fallback. The default language is German.

## Crawling Notes

Public marketing, service, price, booking, gallery, contact, and blog pages are intended for indexing. Internal tool paths and Cloudflare Functions are not public content.
